lesson_plans.name: Balanced Glutes & Core Focus (45 min)
lesson_plans.description: 45-minute class targeting glutes and core with side-lying work and plank variations. Flow: sitting prep → lying core → side lying glutes (both sides) → plank obliques → standing glutes → sitting core → lying core → cool down.

exercise.name: Deep breaths
exercise.description: Deep breathing to center and prepare for practice.

exercise.name: Pilates breaths
exercise.description: Pilates breathing with focus on lateral rib expansion.

exercise.name: Neck rolls
exercise.description: Gentle neck circles to release tension.

exercise.name: Lateral spinal stretch
exercise.description: Lateral spinal stretch to mobilize the spine and open the side body.

warm_up.notes: 5 minutes warm-up. Focus on establishing breath connection and spinal mobility.

exercise.name: Pelvic tilts
exercise.description: From supine, tilt pelvis to imprint and release.

exercise.name: Super slow glute bridge
exercise.description: Very slow controlled glute bridge with reset to floor each time.

exercise.name: Toe taps from table top
exercise.description: From supine with legs in table top, alternate tapping toes to floor.

exercise.name: Knees side to side from table top
exercise.description: Send both knees to right, pull back to centre, both knees to left, pull back to centre.

exercise.name: Crunches
exercise.description: Basic abdominal crunch from supine.

exercise.name: Crunch pulses
exercise.description: Small pulse movements at the top of crunch position.

main_session.notes: Repeat this core series x3 with hugging knees between each round. 10 minutes lying core work. Keep lower back connected to mat throughout.

exercise.name: Side-lying knee bent lift and lower
exercise.description: Side-lying with knees bent, lift and lower top leg keeping knee bent.

exercise.description: With leg extended, flex toe and pulse.

exercise.name: Side-lying leg circles pointed
exercise.description: With leg extended and pointed foot, perform circles changing direction midway.

exercise.name: Side-lying oblique crunch
exercise.description: Oblique crunch bringing knee in and extending.

main_session.notes: 5 minutes left side glute work. Left leg on top.

exercise.name: Plank knee crunch
exercise.description: From plank, bring one knee in and perform bent knee crunches, drawing nose to knee.

main_session.notes: 2 minutes plank oblique work. Right knee in to work left glute.

exercise.name: Squats with heel raised
exercise.description: Squats with one heel raised to target opposite glute.

exercise.name: Wide squat hold
exercise.description: Hold wide squat position.

exercise.name: Side bends in squat
exercise.description: From squat position, perform side bends.

exercise.name: Child's pose
exercise.description: Rest pose with hips back on heels, arms extended forward.

exercise.description: Oblique crunch bringing knee in and extending.

main_session.notes: 5 minutes right side glute work. Right leg on top.

exercise.name: Plank knee crunch
exercise.description: From plank, bring one knee in and perform bent knee crunches, drawing nose to knee.

main_session.notes: 2 minutes plank oblique work. Left knee in to work right glute.

exercise.name: Oblique crunch with twist

exercise.description: Quick tempo bicycle crunches.

main_session.notes: 2 minutes lying core finish.

cool_down.notes: 3 minutes cool down. Focus on lengthening and releasing.
